# ARYAN.CLOUD

> Aryan is an AWS Cloud & Security Engineer specializing in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing), and Server Hardening. Certified: CEH (EC-Council), ISO 27001, AWS Security, CCNA-level Networking.

## Core Expertise
- AWS Cloud: IAM, EC2, S3, VPC, Route53, GuardDuty, KMS
- DevOps: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux server management
- VAPT: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, Kali Linux
- Server Hardening: Fail2Ban, Nginx, SSL/TLS, firewalls, PM2
- Networking: TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP
